summary.scope: ExerciseFactory core only. Other reading, handwriting, games, lesson banks need separate review.

limits: No engine, Flutter, Android, unit or integration tests were run locally for this review.
PNG pixels were fully decoded for integrity; no visual quality or real device FPS approval is asserted.
Source inventories are the original runtime gate selected inventories, not a claim of all tracked repository paths.
The build, Android, update and delivery stages are not covered by these completed-job results.
Old 0b7/baf results were not substituted for 5ad/2281 originals.

An initial derived analysis mistakenly counted all dropping flags (109) rather than the real reader condition of changed coordinates at unchanged disc count (90); it failed before reporting success. Original logs, reader bytes, failed analysis and corrected source-grounded count are retained. This was not a CI failure.
An initial read-only inspector assumed source.files was a dictionary and stopped with AttributeError; corrected inspection used its actual list schema. No original file or CI result changed.
